title: Track review status for each session

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: one break check

Story: .planning/seeds/SEED-418-review-published-session-changes.md#track-review-state-per-session (plan .planning/slice-plans/882-track-review-status-for-each-session/PLAN.md)
Revision: 22391b8da745004c6840e5af0ee5332886375485 (claude/track-review-status-for-each-session)
Promise: "A retained session and its published record count once." In practice, a story mark at T covers a paired kept session at its published closedAt, not its local doneAt.

Verdict: Caught.

Fault (one edit): dashboard/src/recentlyDoneListing.ts, reviewableSession. Changed
  completedAt: published?.closedAt ?? session.doneAt,
to
  completedAt: session.doneAt,
so a paired kept session is credited at its local doneAt. This is the caller's second suggested variant; I used it because the selected fixture (mountKeptCounterpart: kept doneAt 6 min ago, published closedAt 5 min ago, mark 5.5 min ago) separates the two times directly. I did not probe the "stop pairing / count twice" variant.

Maintained checks examined (scratch checkout, same focused command each run):
env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/stories/recently-done-review-coverage-mount.spec.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/stories/recently-done-session-review-mount.spec.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/recently-done-card-membership-mount.spec.ts

Run observations:
- Baseline: exit 0, 15/15 passed across the 3 files. This included the relocated "a kept session and its published record count once, at the published closing time" test and the split-out "the sidebar's Needs review cue follows one session's mark".
- Faulted: exit 1, 2 failed and 13 passed.
  1. recently-done-review-coverage-mount.spec.ts:122 "a kept session and its published record count once, at the published closing time" failed at line 129, `expect.element(card.markAsReviewed).toBeVisible()`. The story's "Mark as reviewed" button was not found.
  2. recently-done-session-review-mount.spec.ts:162 "a kept session and its published record share one mark, and the sidebar cue compares the published closing time" failed at line 171, `expect.element(kept.markAsReviewed).toBeVisible()`.
- Wrong behavior seen separately: the failure's ARIA tree shows the "Explain the CI pause" card with a story-level "Reviewed" button. The "Ad hoc session for Counterpart here" session also shows "Reviewed". So the 5.5-min mark covered the session at its 6-min doneAt instead of leaving it unreviewed at its 5-min closedAt. This is the wrong behavior on the intended path. The relocated assertion catches the doneAt crediting. The split-out sidebar-cue test ("follows one session's mark", line 118) still passed, so it does not cover this fault. Its sibling at line 162 does.
- Restore: `git checkout` ran from an EXIT trap. `git status --porcelain` was empty and `git diff --quiet` was clean at HEAD 22391b8da (the pre-probe state was clean). Rerun: exit 0, 15/15 passed.
- Scratch worktree /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/df49c654/tmp/ic-scratch was removed and pruned. The execution worktree was not touched.

Next proof action: none needed for the doneAt-crediting fault. If double counting needs proof on its own, probe the unpaired variant (pairedPublished not pairing) as a separate check.
Planned repair or prior disposition matched: none known. This probe causes no new repair decision.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, Vitest "Duration"): baseline 10.12 s, faulted 22.68 s (two 15 s matcher timeouts), restored 9.07 s, about 41.9 s in total. npm ci time was not measured separately.
- Human effort: unavailable. No human took part during the check.
- Agent effort: unavailable. Token or turn counts are not visible to this agent. About 12 tool calls is an estimate.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 101581 ms (measured), from 1795775812000 to 1795775913581 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
